questions.q: If CAT is written as DBU, how is DOG written in that code?

questions.q: Amit walks 5 km north, turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right and walks 5 km. How far is he from the start, and in which direction?
questions.explanation: North 5, East 3, then South 5 cancels the northward walk. He is 3 km east of the start.

questions.q: Pointing to a boy, Riya says, "He is the son of my grandfather's only son." How is the boy related to Riya?
questions.explanation: Her grandfather's only son is Riya's father. Her father's son is her brother.

questions.q: If '+' means '×', '×' means '−', '−' means '÷' and '÷' means '+', what is 8 + 2 × 6 − 3 ÷ 1?

questions.q: If today is Monday, what day will it be after 61 days?
questions.explanation: 61 = 8 × 7 + 5. Five days after Monday is Saturday.
